camdrones.planner.field.light.tooltip: The drone's LEDs at this point: leave them, switch them on or off, or pick a mode. Needs an LED strip.
camdrones.planner.field.accessory.toolti: Triggers accessory action 1 to 4 at this point, like the “Accessory action” keys in flight, for example an add-on's dispenser. “Release gripper” drops the cargo; during a mission the gripper grabs by itself when the drone flies low over an item. “Stop repeat” ends a repeat from an earlier point. Without a fitting accessory the action is skipped.
camdrones.planner.field.repeat.tooltip: “only here”: the accessory action runs once at this waypoint. “from here”: at this and at every following waypoint. “every … s” (timed): from this waypoint on at the interval from the field Every, also in flight and while waiting. Both last until a point has another accessory setting or “Stop repeat”, at the latest until the last waypoint.
camdrones.planner.field.every.tooltip: Only when timed: the time between two triggers in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second); the seconds show at Repeat. The timer starts at this waypoint and runs until a waypoint with another accessory setting, at the latest until the last waypoint (not on the way back). An accessory with a minimum interval, such as a dispenser, never fires faster. Click: ±1 tick, Shift: ±20 ticks.
camdrones.planner.support.unknown: Drone out of sight – its equipment is unknown. Actions are checked in flight.
camdrones.planner.support.camera: Camera drone with nav FC: missions with and without a pilot, obstacle sensing depending on the nav FC.
camdrones.planner.support.fpv_pilot: It flies missions only without a pilot: take off the goggles, then Start. With a pilot it stays a normal FPV drone.
camdrones.planner.support.fpv_sensors: Without a nav FC there is no obstacle sensing – the mission flies the planned line.
camdrones.planner.support.gps_missing: GPS: only %1$s of %2$s satellites – no mission starts without open sky
camdrones.planner.support.notice.no_gps: No GPS at the drone (%1$s/%2$s satellites)
camdrones.planner.support.notice.fpv: FPV drone: start only without a pilot
camdrones.planner.support.reason.unknown: Drone out of sight – checked in flight
camdrones.planner.support.reason.no_ligh: this Propwash version does not let add-ons switch the LEDs yet
camdrones.planner.support.reason.no_leds: no LED strip on the drone
camdrones.planner.support.reason.no_acce: no accessory with actions on the drone
camdrones.planner.support.repeated: Repeats the accessory action of waypoint %s
camdrones.planner.support.timed: Continues every %2$s ticks (%3$s s) from waypoint %1$s
camdrones.planner.support.every_limit: At most as often as the accessory allows
